items.summary: topk.cu CUB segmented-sort path not ported; Sort() falls back to an alternative.

marian-dev gfx1101 (Windows) e2e decoder fails: rocBLAS grouped-batched GEMM falls back to a generic SPIR-V (ISA000) kernel that Windows kpack_load_code_object can't load (hipErrorInvalidImage). Fix: add a _WIN32 && USE_HIP path in src/tensors/gpu/prod.cpp ProdBatchedTyped using hipblasGemmStridedBatchedEx (marian batched matrices are contiguous) or a sequential hipblasGemmEx loop -- ELF Tensile dispatch present for gfx1101. Optional platform; advancing head revalidates gfx90a/gfx1100/gfx1201.

Upstream marian bug (pre-existing, identical on CUDA, not a port defect): PoolingOp::type() returns the literal "layer_pooling" for both avg and max mode and overrides neither equal() nor hash() for its mode field, so ExpressionGraph::add()'s short-term CSE aliases an avg_pooling node to a max_pooling node built on the same input in the same graph. Dead in practice -- avg_pooling has zero callers in the tree and max_pooling exactly one (examples/mnist/model_lenet.h) -- so no shipped model path hits it, and the code is CUDNN-gated. Found while writing the gfx90a MIOpen conv/pool correctness check on 2026-08-11; worked around there by giving each pooling mode its own graph. Deferred decision: whether to report it upstream separately from the ROCm port PR.
